game_files.description: Core assets needed to play the game.

io_cars.description: Additional cars created by the community. Used in regular I/O races.

io_cars_bonus.description: Additional cars created by the community. Reserved for special and unofficial events.

io_clockworks.description: The three original Acclaim Clockworks mixed together with thirteen Clockworks by RV_Passion.

io_lms.description: Content for the unofficial Last Man Standing game mode created by the community.

io_loadlevel.description: Loading screens for custom tracks created by Balesz.

io_music.description: Extra music for the I/O track pack.

io_skins.description: Additional skins for cars included in the io_cars package.

io_skins_bonus.description: Additional skins for cars included in the io_cars_bonus package.

io_stunts.description: Additional Stunt Arena content created by the community.

io_tag.description: Additional Battle Tag content created by the community.

io_tracks.description: Additional tracks created by the community. Used in regular I/O races.

io_tracks_bonus.description: Additional tracks created by the community. Reserved for special and unofficial events.

io_tracks_circuit.description: Additional custom tracks used in drifting or other special events.

io_soundtrack.description: Free soundtrack alternative made by the community.

rvgl_linux.description: GNU/Linux binaries for RVGL (x86, x86_64, armhf, aarch64).

rvgl_macos.description: macOS binaries for RVGL (x86_64 and arm64).

rvgl_dcpack.description: Dreamcast content pack for RVGL (Rooftops and additional cars).

cc_cars.description: Original car assets made for the Christmas Championship series.

cc_tracks.description: Track assets used in the Christmas Championship series.
